rca_of_issue: The -26.7% in property card comes from: p.price = 7500000 (list price) but p.purchase_price = 7500000 as well. Current value = 9500000. So (9500000-7500000)/7500000 = +26.67%. But screenshot shows -26.7%. Possible that the 'Indiranagar Home' was saved with current_value=9500000 but purchase_price is null or zero, causing division issue. The backend correctly computes +26.67% using purchase_price fallback to p.price. The frontend card uses p.purchase_price directly without the same fallback logic.
